record.full_color_scope: All3^N assignments of every pin to an outer edge; convex hull each edge region; reject region overlap/shared inner pins; deduplicate hull geometry. Includes all subsets of a10-point general-position pool up to size5 and140 fresh random geometries up to size8.
review: Angular order comparator is strict on the interior wedge at C, whose angle is below180degrees; the input forbids any three collinear points.
For fixed A/B first contacts, all-left intersection gives an inclusive lower C rank, all-right intersection gives an inclusive upper rank; the two opposite triangle orientations are both checked.
Q-left-of-C imposes rankR<rankQ; P-left-of-B is filtered directly; R-left-of-A is counted by prefix sums.
Sentinel rank0 represents the unbent C→A band; n0 safely uses no bit words and returns1.
At coordinate magnitude1e8 the turn expression is within8e16; all accumulated counts are bounded by(501)^3<126million, within int.
Nonzero bit guards precede clz/ctz and no unused trailing bits are set.
record.limits: Independent geometric full assignments cover small N; maximum-size checks use affine/vertex-order invariance, not exhaustive shape enumeration.

annotation_format_edit.scope: Commented code copies only: restore blank lines and two-space note delimiter; clarify angular-order note.
